title: Generative Model Experiment
description: Train or fine-tune a small generative model (VAE, GAN, or diffusion surrogate) on a bounded public dataset, implement a fixed generation benchmark, and report sample-quality metrics plus failure cases with analysis.
learningObjectives: Implement a small generative architecture end-to-end
Define a fixed, seeded sample-benchmark protocol
Report quantitative metrics (FID-like proxy or reconstruction score) with honesty about limits
Analyze mode collapse or blur artifacts concretely

milestones.title: Generative model implementation
milestones.objective: Implement one generative architecture (VAE/GAN/diffusion) sized to finish training on a small dataset.
milestones.expectedOutput: Model + training loop that terminates with checkpoints.

milestones.title: Fixed benchmark protocol
milestones.objective: Define a fixed, seeded generation benchmark (N samples, fixed prompts/noise) recorded in a file.

milestones.title: Quality metrics
milestones.objective: Measure at least two metrics (e.g. reconstruction MSE for VAE, an FID proxy or distance-based score).
milestones.expectedOutput: Metric table in the report with formulas.

milestones.title: Failure analysis
milestones.objective: Show worst generations and explain artifacts (blur, collapse, artifacts) with a hypothesis.

categories.excellentExpectation: Checks catch nondeterminism across identical runs
Failure gallery treated as first-class evidence

criteria: Tests for data pipeline and metrics
categories.excellentExpectation: Fixture run validating the whole loop on a tiny dataset

constraints: Bounded compute: state GPU-hours; avoid unbounded training
Data licensed for redistribution or downloaded by script
hints: A small VAE with honest metrics beats a GAN that half-converges: fidelity of evaluation is the point of this project

requiredEvidence.description: Repository with model, training, and benchmark.
